title: Deep Patrol
description: Navigate through waypoints deep in enemy territory. Each waypoint brings new challenges as you push further into Kilrathi space.
intro: Command has identified key Kilrathi positions along the frontier. Your patrol route takes you through three sectors. Reach each waypoint, complete your objectives, and report back alive.
outro: Outstanding work, pilot! Your deep patrol has provided critical intelligence on Kilrathi positions. The Confederation fleet can now plan a full offensive. You are cleared for shore leave.

missions.name: Sector Sweep
missions.briefing: A simple two-waypoint patrol. Navigate to the first waypoint through an asteroid field, then proceed to the second waypoint where enemy scouts have been spotted.
missions.debriefing: Sector clear. Good flying out there.

missions.name: Gauntlet Run
missions.briefing: Intelligence reports three Kilrathi outposts along a patrol route. Fly through each waypoint, survive the resistance, and destroy all hostiles.
missions.debriefing: All three outposts neutralized. The corridor is open for our fleet.
